design_archetype: Luxury Hospitality & Precision Operations (Archetype 5 Luxury + Tactical Precision)

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-semibold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-medium tracking-tight

colors.theme: Dark Warm Hospitality with Tactical Accents

layout_and_spacing.header_nav: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-md bg-[#120E0D]/90 border-b border-[#332B25]

sections: Hero section with warm video/photo overlay and 'Reserve a Table' primary CTA
Step-by-step table reservation form (Date, Time slot, Guest count, Seating zone preference: Main Dining / Cocktail Bar / Patio, Special requests & Dietary allergies)
Instant confirmation screen with booking reference code
Opening hours, location map mock, contact info

staff_portal.login: Email & Password authentication with pre-populated demo credentials

views.name: Live Floor Plan
views.features: Interactive 2D table layout with status indicators (Free, Seated, Reserved, Needs Cleaning). Drag or click tables to edit status, assign reservation, view current bill/timer, mark cleaned.

views.name: Reservations Calendar & Day View
views.features: Day/Week timeline switcher with filter by status (Pending, Confirmed, Seated, Completed, Cancelled, No-show). Quick status update actions and search.

views.name: Guest List & CRM
views.features: Guest profile card list with total visits, lifetime spend in EUR, dietary notes/allergies, VIP tag toggle, past reservation history, and staff notes.

views.name: Quick Walk-in Seating
views.features: One-click seating tool to quickly assign an unreserved table to walk-in guests.

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill or sleek rounded buttons (`rounded-lg`), subtle glow on hover, primary gold CTA `#D4A359` with dark text `#120E0D`, secondary dark warm outline button.
component_guidelines.tables: Dark warm background, soft gold/bronze header text, hover row highlighting, status badges with clear high-contrast dots.
component_guidelines.floor_plan_nodes: Visual shape representations (round tables for 2-4p, rectangular for 6-8p, bar counters). Status color borders, capacity badges, live timer for seated tables.
component_guidelines.modals: Dark backdrop overlay `bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-sm`, clean borders `border-[#332B25]`, clear close buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript / React (.js files) according to existing repository configuration.
Ensure currency symbol is always Euro (€).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='reservation-submit-btn', data-testid='table-status-free').
Never use generic Inter font for headings; stick to Cormorant Garamond for titles and Plus Jakarta Sans/Outfit for clean operational UI.
Keep staff back-office login seamless with pre-filled demo accounts for easy testing.
